triage_rule: Missing metadata triggers source verification, not automatic exclusion

primary_scope: Cu, Cd, Zn, Ni, Pb, Ag, Cr, or Hg
triage_rule: Generic trace/heavy-metal wording alone requires metal-identity verification
Freshwater-only evidence can be classified outside the thesis scope
Missing laboratory wording requires source verification
Missing waterborne wording requires source verification

primary_scope: At least one separate single-metal exposure arm
triage_rule: Mixture or multi-metal studies are retained if separate single-metal arms may exist
Mortality or lethal response must be confirmed
LC50 must be confirmed from the source
Only explicit LC50 durations outside 24-96 h constitute a metadata-level duration failure

primary_scope: Usable point estimate rather than only a censored/range value
triage_rule: The full paper, table, figure, or supplement may provide the usable point estimate

primary_scope: Chemical identity and concentration basis sufficiently interpretable
triage_rule: Nanoparticles, Cr forms, zinc pyrithione, leaching, and ambiguous bases require source review

primary_scope: Plain Primary evidence separated from deliberate modifier treatments
triage_rule: Modifier studies are not treated as invalid; plain and modifier evidence are separated

primary_scope: At least one eligible LC50 Result in the source is sufficient to move the Reference to result-level extraction
triage_rule: Reference-level eligibility does not equal one Result and does not automatically add data to the thesis dataset

primary_scope: Assessed only after eligible Results are extracted across all eight metals
triage_rule: Do not use current Cu-Cd-Zn model membership as an eligibility rule
